fast.why: Next sunnah fast is Monday 30 Nov: the Prophet ﷺ said that is the day he was born and revelation began, and deeds are presented on Mondays.

blessing: Your time and your Friday: Jumaat is the best day of the week, a built-in pause in a busy week. Show shukr by going a little early to the masjid and saying 'Alhamdulillah' for the chance.

verse.text: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

hadith.text: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Purity is half of faith, and 'Alhamdulillah' fills the scale."

lesson.title: Names of Allah: Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim
lesson.text: Every Fatihah in solat begins with these two names (1:3). Ar-Rahman is mercy that covers all creation; Ar-Rahim is special mercy for the believers. Allah says, 'My mercy encompasses all things' (7:156). When work feels harsh, remember the One you pray to describes Himself first by mercy.

name.text: The Prophet ﷺ said no one is more patient than Allah over harmful words He hears (Bukhari 6099). He gives time and still provides. Be patient with yourself too.
"Indeed, I am Ever-Forgiving to whoever repents, believes and does good" (20:82). Close the day with istighfar.

world.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set it at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, AI and great-power rivalry.
Forecasters' chance of a 'World War Three' before 2050 (10M+ deaths, major powers involved).
Prof Jiang's latest lectures on geopolitics and where great-power conflict is heading.

Nuclear deterrence makes all-out war a losing move for every major power, so the stable outcome (flashing) is 'compete, don't fight': trade wars, arms races and proxy conflicts. The real danger is a misread in a crisis like Taiwan or Ukraine, which is why the clock and the forecast are rising. Meter: 2 of 5.
